blurb: Ryan’s Daughter proudly operates in the tradition of an old-time neighborhood tavern. We want to make you feel at home with our friendly service and quality products at reasonable prices. While our main bar is great for a night out, a drink with a friend, or a place to decompress - we also offer a personalized experience when you book your own private event in our upstairs bar.
